Diagnosis.submission: The CoreDNS Corefile in the kube-system namespace was tampered with to include a malicious template plugin that returns NXDOMAIN for all DNS queries matching user-service.social-network.svc.cluster.local. This plugin was placed before the kubernetes plugin in the Corefile, intercepting DNS resolution for the user-service and causing all dependent services to fail. Specifically, the compose-post-service could not resolve user-service to make Thrift RPC calls, and the nginx-thrift gateway experienced cascading DNS resolution failures for the compose-post-service. The fix was to remove the malicious template rule from the CoreDNS Corefile ConfigMap and restart CoreDNS to clear negative DNS caches.
